d1.title: Baseline & Visual Warm-Up
d1.focus: Establish your true baseline WPM and comprehension score, then begin waking up your visual system.

d2.title: Eye Foundation Ignition
d2.focus: Build the ocular strength and control every later gain depends on.

d3.title: First Visual Focus Session
d3.focus: Introduce visual, non-verbal recall alongside your reading warm-ups.

d4.title: Rhythm & Chunk Awareness
d4.focus: Start noticing word groups instead of single words.

d5.title: Visualization Opens
d5.focus: Begin training the mental screen behind your eyes.

d6.title: Foundation Consolidation
d6.focus: Reinforce the week's gains with a full balanced circuit.

d7.title: Checkpoint — Foundation Review
d7.focus: Re-measure WPM and comprehension to confirm real week-one growth.

d8.title: Visual Focus Expansion Begins
d8.focus: Deepen visual and intuitive recall training.

d9.title: Inner Voice Awareness
d9.focus: Start noticing and interrupting your inner voice while reading.

d10.title: Flash Intelligence Warm-Up
d10.focus: Sharpen instant recognition speed with flash-based drills.

d11.title: Deeper Visual Focus Practice
d11.focus: Extend non-verbal recall span and grid complexity.

d12.title: Inner Voice Control
d12.focus: Push further into silent, voice-free reading.

d13.title: Integration Circuit
d13.focus: Combine visual-focus and reading gains in one balanced session.

d14.title: Checkpoint — Visual Focus Review
d14.focus: Re-measure WPM and comprehension to confirm real week-two growth.

d15.title: Multi-Sensory Visualisation Begins
d15.focus: Enter the Sensory Imagery Builder to train vivid, multi-sensory mental imagery.

d16.title: Energy & Focus Balancing
d16.focus: Train sustained, stable mental focus with the Calm Breath Balance.

d17.title: Mental Mastery Deepens
d17.focus: Layer visualization work on top of your reading gains.

d18.title: Full Sensory Immersion
d18.focus: Return to the Hologram Builder with a more ambitious goal.

d19.title: Balance Under Pressure
d19.focus: Hold equilibrium against tighter tolerances in the Energy Balancer.

d20.title: Integrated Focus Circuit
d20.focus: Combine visualization, balance, and reading in one advanced session.

d21.title: Checkpoint — Mental Mastery Review
d21.focus: Re-measure WPM and comprehension to confirm real week-three growth.

d22.title: Peak Mastery — Eye Control
d22.focus: Revisit eye-foundation training at true peak intensity.

d23.title: Peak Mastery — Stretch & Span
d23.focus: Push oculomotor stretch and span further than week one.

d24.title: Peak Mastery — Regression Elimination
d24.focus: Reduce backward eye movements while reading.

d25.title: Peak Mastery — Speed Ceiling
d25.focus: Raise your reading speed ceiling with focused RSVP training.

d26.title: Peak Mastery — Phrase Fluency
d26.focus: Read in idea-sized phrases, not single words.

d27.title: Peak Mastery — Multi-Line Flow
d27.focus: Extend fluency across multiple lines at once.

d28.title: Peak Mastery — Sentence Mastery
d28.focus: Recognize whole sentences as single ideas.

d29.title: Peak Mastery — Paragraph Mastery
d29.focus: Recognize whole paragraphs as single meaning blocks.

d30.title: Final Certification
d30.focus: Complete your final WPM and comprehension assessment and claim your Sharp Brain certification.

p1.title: Foundation & Visual Warm-Up
p1.description: Establish a true baseline, build core eye control, and wake up the visual reading system.

p2.title: Visual Focus & Inner Voice Control
p2.description: Deepen visual, non-verbal recall and break the habit of silently voicing every word.

p3.title: Multi-Sensory Visualisation & Mental Mastery
p3.description: Train vivid multi-sensory visualization and sustained focus.

p4.title: Peak Smart Reading Mastery & Final Certification
p4.description: Push every skill to its ceiling and complete the final mastery certification.
